template.name: Comparison
template.when: Two or more things set side by side: what they are, how they differ and which wins.

sections.heading: What is compared
sections.hint: Name the things and say why they are being compared.

widgets.markdown: Name each thing compared and the question the comparison answers.

sections.heading: Side by side
sections.hint: One row per aspect, one column per thing.

sections.heading: Where they differ
sections.hint: A chart of the one number that differs most, or the differences that matter in a short list.

sections.heading: Verdict
sections.hint: Which one and why, in a sentence or two.

widgets.title: Verdict
widgets.markdown: Name the winner and the reason that decides it.
